channel.title: Real estate · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Real estate in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.0).

item.title: [+2] RBI Office Attendant Score Card 2026 Out - Download Cut Off PDF
item.description:
Signal: RBI easing (India). 3 reports from KNN India, ETLegalWorld.com, FreeJobAlert.Com. Related: “RBI Eases Export Declaration, Import Reporting Rules for Small Service Traders”. New in the last 24 hours.

Real estate: tailwind (+2) — Cheaper home loans

Why it matters: A lower repo rate cuts loan rates and bond yields, supporting housing, vehicle sales and borrowing, though lenders' margins narrow.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1, Growth outlook +1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Eurozone bond yields steady as investors await inflation data; US Treasury yields ease after midterm elect
item.description:
Signal: falling US Treasury yields (US). 9 reports from TradingView, marketscreener.com, Moomoo and 2 more. Related: “US election results could slow AI data-centre investments, support Treasury bonds: Report”. New in the last 24 hours.

Real estate: mild tailwind (+1) — Funding costs ease

Why it matters: Lower US rates and yields send foreign money back to emerging markets, supporting the rupee, Indian bonds and equities.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows +3, Rupee +1, Bond market (G-Secs) +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] The Federal Reserve isn't the only central bank to hike rates in 2026: What global tightening means for investors
item.description:
Signal: tighter US monetary policy (US). 3 reports from ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos, Chase Bank, Pluang. Related: “Four insurance stocks benefit as Fed rate hikes boost bond yields and investment income.”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 29 Oct).

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs rise

Why it matters: Higher US rates and yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −2, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] RBI rejects bids for 182-day T-Bills as investors seek higher yields amid tight liquidity
item.description:
Signal: rising Indian bond yields (India). 4 reports from Moneycontrol.com, BusinessLine, Finimize. Related: “India’s US Treasury holdings climbed to $220 billion in August as RBI absorbed record dollar inflows”. Turn: earlier readings (3 Nov) pointed the other way.

Real estate: mild headwind (−1) — Funding costs rise

Why it matters: Higher G-Sec yields raise borrowing costs across the economy and cause mark-to-market losses on banks' bond holdings.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
